bio: Bold graffiti art and a dark palette of black and red create an intimate and laid-back feel. In the kitchen, the cuisines of Japan, China, Thailand and Indonesia artfully rub shoulders. The chef always manages to dose just the right spices, creating dishes full of rich flavours and crisp textures. Whether you opt for sushi, dim sum, Peking duck or sea bass with panang curry, this Asian culinary adventure puts authenticity front and centre....
